g.text: E014 prototype: KV OFF and KV ON measured latency
Separate contracts: v1 = eager trim + legacy timing; v2 = amortized trim + owned lifecycle. One fresh process per panel column.
Actual N values; synthetic repeated real-KV state, not long generation. 3 ABBA rounds → six formal observations per arm and point.
Large markers = process medians; faint dots = every formal timing (observed spread, not a confidence interval).
v1 times restore + draft; v2 times draft + own teardown, with prepare outside. Policy, timing, and pool changed; cross-version ms differences have no single-variable attribution.
